11046|28b8dee2.name: Whuut
11046|28b8dee2.text: Why should I pace myself if this is working?

11048|2479a86b.name: Victor Ward
11048|2479a86b.text: Yes, I think you have potential. Maybe I can show you a thing or two.

11049|041039a1.name: Rhiannon Davis
11049|041039a1.text: How can I share my secrets with a beginner? Try speaking with Victor Ward first.

14729|9e055276.name: Ralston Farnsley
14729|9e055276.text:
You there... it is in your best interest to aid the Forsaken during these dire times.  Listen closely, as I dislike repeating myself.

We currently find ourselves in a dire shortage of cloth.  Bandages and simple textiles are running low, and donations are being accepted to bolster sagging inventories.  While you'll not receive financial compensation - hence what donation means - your aid will not go unnoticed.

2129|39920e92.name: Dark Cleric Beryl
2129|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

2132|db927cdf.name: Carolai Anise
2132|db927cdf.text: Nice to see a friendly face. I don't get much chitchat from Apothecary Johaan unless he wants something. He's been out of the grave too long. Someday I'll be like that, I hear. Creepy. Maybe by then I won't care.

2704|15da2919.name: Hanashi
2704|15da2919.text: Heya mon.  You come right place learn how ta wield a new weapon.

3318|6b36598f.name: Koma
3318|6b36598f.text: I guarantee this bank's security with my own blood, is that good enough for you?

3347|9cc6e14a.name: Yelmak
3347|9cc6e14a.text: I'm busy, $N. Tell Whuut to handle whatever it is. That young pup has been stewing all day long. He spends much more time like that, and he's going to hurt something.

3368|5a0b913d.name: Borstan
3368|5a0b913d.text: I have the finest meats in Orgrimmar.

3373|6043e59b.name: Arnok
3373|6043e59b.text: I am an orc of medicine, $r. If you have come here to learn, I shall do my best to teach.

3432|c1a3099b.name: Mankrik
3432|c1a3099b.text:
I came to the Crossroads from the south seeking help, $c, but I find only cowards who turn their backs on me--even the mighty Thork insults me so. He is a good leader, but his dismissal of my plea causes me greater anger.

He claims my rage makes me hasty--that it clouds my judgement--but I will not rest until I have vengeance!

3448|dcea3712.name: Tonga Runetotem
3448|dcea3712.text: The times we live in are as fickle as the shifting winds, $c.  It is important to remember what is true and lasting in this world, and to preserve that.  Everything else is a waste.

3615|ddd7878b.name: Devrak
3615|ddd7878b.text: My wind riders are trained to fly quickly through the hot Barrens air.

3934|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Boorand Plainswind
3934|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

4606|39920e92.name: Aelthalyste
4606|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

4607|39920e92.name: Father Lankester
4607|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

4608|39920e92.name: Father Lazarus
4608|39920e92.text: What can this insignificant servant do for you, $N? Training perhaps?

4608|8fca8484.name: Father Lazarus
4608|8fca8484.text: If you desire, in addition to training, I have it within my power to erase the knowledge of your talents from your mind.  Be warned that every time you undergo this procedure the more difficult it is to perform, and therefore the more expensive it becomes.

4773|0450da3d.name: Velma Warnam
4773|0450da3d.text: I can teach you the finer points of Skeletal Horse Riding, provided you have enough gold to cover the lesson!

5688|fde1fb79.name: Innkeeper Renee
5688|fde1fb79.text: Rest your weary bones for a spell.

6018|10137e12.name: Ur'kyo
6018|10137e12.text: I do what me can to train you in the priestly ways, if that what you be here for.

7231|248686cb.name: Kelgruk Bloodaxe
7231|248686cb.text: What is it? Can't you see I'm busy?

1061-accept.name: Zor Lonetree
1061-accept.text:
The spirits of the Stonetalon Mountains are angered, for goblins and their servants are plundering and burning the land.  So the land has cried out, and those who listen for such things... have heard.

Seereth Stonebreak, a promising shaman of the Horde, was sent to Stonetalon.  She reports massive deforestation at the hands of the goblins, and requests aid.

Meet Seereth in Stonetalon.  To reach her, follow the road west of the Barrens' Crossroads.  She is camped near the Greatwood Vale.
1061-accept.title: The Spirits of Stonetalon

3281-accept.name: Gazrog
3281-accept.text:
You may have killed the raptors, but the silver they stole must be recovered!  I have reports that the raptors have a large grouping of nests south of Ratchet, known as the Raptor Grounds.  It is likely that they brought our stolen silver there.

Go to this raptor haven and search for the stolen silver.  When you find it, return it to me.
3281-accept.title: Stolen Silver

354-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
354-accept.text:
The Agamand family was the most prosperous family in Tirisfal Glades.  I used to work their mills...before the Plague.

When the Scourge first came, the Agamands fortified their home and convinced those in their employ to remain and help them defend.  We were fools, but at least we were loyal fools.

The Agamands, in their pride, doomed us to undeath.  And now they are minions of the Scourge!

Serve the Forsaken by defeating the Agamands who fell to the Plague.  Serve me by bringing me their remains.
354-accept.title: Deaths in the Family

354-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
354-complete.text:
Revenge has a sweet taste, don't you think?  When you destroyed the Agamands, did you catch any hint of free will within them?  I hope so.  I hope they knew fear before they were smashed into oblivion.

It is a foolish hope, I know.  But it is a hope I foster nonetheless.
354-complete.title: Deaths in the Family

354-progress.name: Coleman Farthing
354-progress.text: Do you have the remains of the Agamands?  Are those cursed beasts finally destroyed?
354-progress.title: Deaths in the Family

355-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
355-accept.text:
You have given me the remains of the Agamands, and satisfied my desire for revenge.  But the Agamand Mills hold a threat to all the Forsaken, not just to me.

I have spoken to Magistrate Sevren of your exploits against the Agamands, and he wishes to speak with you.
355-accept.title: Speak with Sevren

355-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
355-complete.text:
Coleman speaks well of you, $N, telling of your successful forays into the Agamand Mills.

The Forsaken have need of your talents once again...
355-complete.title: Speak with Sevren

356-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
356-complete.text: Very good. Your efforts do much to keep the Scourge at bay. A commendation will be sent to my superior, Executor Zygand.
356-complete.title: Rear Guard Patrol

358-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-complete.text:
Expertly done, $N.  The Scourge are mistaken if they think they can use those corpses against us, and the fluid you gathered from the Rot Hide slaves will be studied by our Apothecaries.  It may have secrets we can use against them.

As I said, well done.  But our struggle continues, and the conflict will surely offer you more chances to prove your worth to the Forsaken.
358-complete.title: Graverobbers

358-progress.name: Magistrate Sevren
358-progress.text: Is your task complete?  Have you destroyed those dog-things and drained them of their ichor?
358-progress.title: Graverobbers

359-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
359-accept.text:
I need a fresh report from our Deathguard waystation to the east.

I must know if more Scourge forces have slipped past The Bulwark and into Tirisfal.  Our vigilance on the border to the Plaguelands must be maintained - we can't let the Scourge get a stronger foothold here!

Travel south along the road, then east at the fork to the waystation.  Speak with Deathguard Linnea.  She has the information I need.
359-accept.title: Forsaken Duties

359-complete.name: Deathguard Linnea
359-complete.text:
Magistrate Sevren wants a report?  Very well: the defenders at The Bulwark are holding the majority of the Scourge at bay, but some do slip through on occasion.

We have seen sporadic Scourge activity east of this station, with a concentration around the Balnir Farmstead.
359-complete.title: Forsaken Duties

360-accept.name: Deathguard Linnea
360-accept.text:
Now return to Magistrate Sevren with the information I gave you.  He'll want it as soon as possible, so be swift.

And if you see any Scourge on your way back, take them down - we can't let them wander our lands unchallenged.
360-accept.title: Return to the Magistrate

360-complete.name: Magistrate Sevren
360-complete.text:
It is troubling to hear of the Scourge slipping past the Bulwark.  The Lich King and his minions are ceaseless in their assaults.

But we will not give in.  He will not take us again!
360-complete.title: Return to the Magistrate

362-accept.name: Coleman Farthing
362-accept.text:
Devlin Agamand was the younger of two sons in the Agamand family, and in life the two could not be more different.  Thurman was tall and gentle while his younger brother was weak and sharp tongued.

When Agamand Mills fell to the Plague, I was not surprised to hear that Devlin was quick to succumb.  His mad chattering can still be heard near the road leading to the Agamand Mills.

I'm collecting the remains of the Agamands, and I want poor Devlin.  Find him, destroy him, and bring me his bones.
362-accept.title: The Haunted Mills

362-complete.name: Coleman Farthing
362-complete.text:
Thank you.  Devlin's bones will rest nicely on my mantle.

If my cold heart can find warmth, it is in knowing that the Agamands are destroyed.  They failed me and my family when the Plague came - now I swear I will smash their remains under my heel!
362-complete.title: The Haunted Mills

368-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-complete.text: The scales are perfect, $N. Exactly what I needed for this concoction.
368-complete.title: A New Plague

368-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
368-progress.text: $N, were you able to obtain 5 Vile Fin Scales from the Murlocs?
368-progress.title: A New Plague

369-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-accept.text:
While you were out gathering, I uncovered some old text in one of my tomes that indicates that an ancient plague wiped out thousands of innocent victims.  Later it was discovered that the deadly agent in the plague was preserved through the venom of Night Web Spiders.

Bring me some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider to complete this experiment.  I want to see if the contagious element from the venom will work with my new concoction.  Rumor has it the spiders can be found in Eastern Tirisfal Glades.
369-accept.title: A New Plague

369-complete.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-complete.text: Ah, this venom will do perfectly, $N.  Everything else has been added to my concoction and boiled down.  Finally, I am ready to try this new deadly agent!
369-complete.title: A New Plague

369-progress.name: Apothecary Johaan
369-progress.text: Do you have some venom from a Vicious Night Web Spider yet, $N?  It's the final component I need in order to test my experiment.
369-progress.title: A New Plague

371-complete.name: Executor Zygand
371-complete.text: Captain Vachon's death will slow down the Scarlet Crusade's advancement in Tirisfal quite a bit.  But other threats loom.
371-complete.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

372-accept.name: Executor Zygand
372-accept.text:
Scarlet Crusaders have been raiding from the ruined tower in northern Tirisfal, past Faol's Rest.  According to the information we have, a ruthless commander named Captain Melrache is in charge of this evil crew.

I am entrusting you now with a special and dangerous mission.  Slay Melrache and his two bodyguards, in the name of The Dark Lady.
372-accept.title: At War With The Scarlet Crusade

374-progress.name: Deathguard Burgess
374-progress.text: Have you collected 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings yet, $c?
374-progress.title: Proof of Demise

375-complete.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-complete.text: I appreciate your efforts, $N.  May Sylvanas recognize your bravery one day. . . .
375-complete.title: The Chill of Death

375-progress.name: Gretchen Dedmar
375-progress.text: Do you have five Duskbat Pelts and some Coarse Thread yet, $N?
375-progress.title: The Chill of Death

398-complete.name: Executor Zygand
398-complete.text: Maggot Eye's dastardly acts have finally been avenged.  Maybe your acts of valor will send a clear message to those who wish to bring harm to our people.  On behalf of the town of Brill I thank you, $N.
398-complete.title: WANTED: Maggot Eye

405-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
405-accept.text:
Bethor Iceshard, a high-ranking and powerful mage in the Undercity to the south, commands me to send him an agent with proven worth against the Scourge.  You, $N, will be that agent.

Present these orders to Bethor.  He will then instruct you on your mission.  I don't know its details, but it deals with recruiting a wayward Lich.  And it will be dangerous.

So ready yourself, $C.  You must not fail.

You may find Bethor in the Magic Quarter of the Undercity.
405-accept.title: The Prodigal Lich

407-complete.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-complete.text: By the Light!  Finally some food!  Sweet, sweet pumpkin. . . .
407-complete.title: Fields of Grief

407-progress.name: Captured Scarlet Zealot
407-progress.text:
Stay away, foul and unholy creature!  May the Light protect me!  The Scarlet Crusade shall rid Azeroth of your. . .

. . .oh wait.  Is that food for me?  I am so hungry. . .
407-progress.title: Fields of Grief

408-accept.name: Magistrate Sevren
408-accept.text:
The Agamand Mills area has become a foothold for the Scourge.  Their strongest point is the Agamand Family Crypt where their local military leader, a skeleton named Captain Dargol, has headquartered.  With Necromancy he has raised the ancestors of the Agamands and plans to use them against us.

This cannot pass, and you must stop it.  Travel to the Agamand Family Crypt and defeat the raised Agamand ancestors.

And, bring me the skull of Captain Dargol.
408-accept.title: The Family Crypt

423-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
423-progress.text: I will need 6 Glutton Shackles and 3 Darksoul Shackles before I can assess the situation and devise a final solution for Arugal.  Now heed your bidding and slay Moonrage Gluttons and Moonrage Darksouls until you have what I need.
423-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

424-progress.name: Dalar Dawnweaver
424-progress.text: Has Grimson the Pale been slain?  Varimathras will not be pleased if we ignore his bidding.
424-progress.title: Arugal's Folly

425-progress.name: Rane Yorick
425-progress.text: Have you killed Ivar the Foul?  If you won't do it for me and my brother, then do it for the Forsaken.
425-progress.title: Ivar the Foul

426-complete.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-complete.text: Your efforts in the war are felt among us, $N.  I will not thank you for doing what is necessary, but the Deathguards of Tirisfal will remember your name.
426-complete.title: The Mills Overrun

426-progress.name: Deathguard Dillinger
426-progress.text: Our battles with the Scourge wage on, $N.  Do your part and throw those cursed, mindless $r back into the Plaguelands!
426-progress.title: The Mills Overrun

445-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
445-accept.text:
Time is a luxury that is not afforded to those of us under the employ of Lady Sylvanas.  Surely you know this by now.

As a member of the Royal Apothecary Society it is my duty to share my knowledge with my colleagues so that our collective efforts might one day provide The Dark Lady with the New Plague she so badly desires.

Take these findings to Apothecary Renferrel who is stationed at The Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest.  Follow the roads to the south from Brill.  From the Undercity go southwest.
445-accept.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-complete.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-complete.text:
Ah, how good of Apothecary Johaan to send his research.  With so many new developments here in Silverpine, I nearly forgot about the findings coming out of Lordaeron and Tirisfal Glades.  Which reminds me, I need to get those samples off to the Necropolis soon.

But you must excuse my rambling.  Extend your stay in Silverpine, $N.  We could use an able bodied $c like you around here.
445-complete.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

445-progress.name: Apothecary Renferrel
445-progress.text: What business do you have with me, $c?
445-progress.title: Delivery to Silverpine Forest

492-accept.name: Apothecary Johaan
492-accept.text:
According to the Deathguard, another one of those foolish Dwarven Mountaineers has just been captured.  The Deathguard likes to use the cellar of the Gallows End Tavern as a holding cell until prisoners can be "properly" dealt with.

Why don't you go see how the Captured Mountaineer enjoys this special drink I made for him?  It contains a subtle hint of what The Dark Lady has planned for the rest of Azeroth.
492-accept.title: A New Plague

492-complete.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-complete.text: Ah, a drink at last.  I'm sure it's no Rhapsody Malt but I'll take anything to whet the old whistle at this point.
492-complete.title: A New Plague

492-progress.name: Captured Mountaineer
492-progress.text: Why if I had my trusted rifle you'd be as good as dead, $C.  Just wait until the Steam Tank Brigade arrives to rescue me!
492-progress.title: A New Plague

4921-accept.name: Mankrik
4921-accept.text:
We battled in a small tauren camp when we were separated--she held three of the Bristlebacks off by herself. But the odds began to overwhelm us. I led some away only to see her overwhelmed by newcomers. In my rage, I turned to face my enemies, but they brought me down easily with their vast numbers.

I awoke to a tauren druid tending my wounds--he had come across me on the Gold Road as I fell.

Please, $c, find some sign of my wife.
4921-accept.title: Lost in Battle

5041-progress.name: Thork
5041-progress.text: How goes your search for the supplies, $N? I trust the quilboar fall under your strength easily.
5041-progress.title: Supplies for the Crossroads

5482-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
5482-progress.text: This had better be good. I trust you have all of the doom weed that I require?
5482-progress.title: Doom Weed

5658-complete.name: Aelthalyste
5658-complete.text: Ah, young priestess, I am glad you have returned here. I would teach you a lesson you would do well to not forget. Are you prepared?
5658-complete.title: Touch of Weakness

6321-complete.name: Karos Razok
6321-complete.text: Ah, an order for supplies.  You will want to take this to the Undercity, no doubt.  And quickly, for the Sepulcher must not be left under stocked.
6321-complete.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6321-progress.name: Karos Razok
6321-progress.text: You appear to be on official business...
6321-progress.title: Supplying the Sepulcher

6322-progress.name: Michael Garrett
6322-progress.text: If you must travel a long distance, then a bat is your best option.
6322-progress.title: Michael Garrett

6323-progress.name: Gordon Wendham
6323-progress.text: I keep my weapons in top condition.  They are cleaned and ready for use.
6323-progress.title: Ride to the Undercity

844-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
844-progress.text: Have you collected the plainstrider beaks?
844-progress.title: Plainstrider Menace

845-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
845-progress.text: How many zhevra have you slain?
845-progress.title: The Zhevra

848-complete.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-complete.text:
Ah, yes.  These are good specimens.  Potent.

I am Forsaken, and we honor our contracts.  Here is your reward, $N.
848-complete.title: Fungal Spores

848-progress.name: Apothecary Helbrim
848-progress.text: Do you have the spores, $N?  There is a concoction I must send to my associate in Thunder Bluff, which requires the spores...
848-progress.title: Fungal Spores

850-progress.name: Regthar Deathgate
850-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Do you have Barak's Head for me?
850-progress.title: Kolkar Leaders

858-progress.name: Wizzlecrank's Shredder
858-progress.text: $N, we need to get out of here before someone gets suspicious!
858-progress.title: Ignition

867-complete.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-complete.text: Oh, these are nice. Real nice... Good job, $N. I look forward to seeing more of your work in the future.
867-complete.title: Harpy Raiders

867-progress.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
867-progress.text: Cut up enough of them yet? Keep slicing and taking trophies. I want 8 Witchwing talons.
867-progress.title: Harpy Raiders

869-complete.name: Gazrog
869-complete.text:
You got rid of the raptors!

Thank you, $N.  You are a $c of worth.
869-complete.title: Raptor Thieves

870-complete.name: Tonga Runetotem
870-complete.text:
You found a fissure in the earth, with gases bubbling from it?  Strange.  This may be an answer to our questions, but we cannot yet be sure.

But it is a clue.  And I am grateful that you found it.
870-complete.title: The Forgotten Pools

872-progress.name: Thork
872-progress.text:
Cut off the head of their leader, and chaos ensues, $N. Learn this lesson well. It will aid you in the future.

The boars will flounder without direction, and we will be able to take back the Barrens.
872-progress.title: The Disruption Ends

875-accept.name: Darsok Swiftdagger
875-accept.text:
Hahaha, $N. Back for more? Good, I like to hear that.

This time I want you to assassinate some of the harpy lieutenants in the Dry Hills. Only Witchwing Slayers can be lieutenants, and you can tell them apart by the rings they carry. They are a nasty bunch, but they lead some of the underlings in that area. Taking out 6 of them will be a decisive strike against their matriarchy.

Make sure they die painfully, $N. We want those harpy wenches to know the idiocy of picking fights with the Horde.
875-accept.title: Harpy Lieutenants

877-accept.name: Tonga Runetotem
877-accept.text:
Like the one you found at the Forgotten Pools, there may be fissures at the other oases in the Barrens.  If so, then perhaps the fissures are the oases' source of life.

We must test this.

Here, take these seeds.  They are dead and infertile, but take them to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast.  If there is a fissure there, then place the seeds within it...and observe.
877-accept.title: The Stagnant Oasis

881-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-accept.text:
Whitemist, Echeyakee in the Tauren tongue, is the king of the savannah cats.  He hunts with such stealth, they say he's like a thin, white mist on the earth.  And he kills so fast his prey have no time for fear, or pain.

The Tauren say he is both mercy and death.

You will learn if that's true, for I now set you on the path to hunt Echeyakee.  His lair is northeast of the Crossroads, among the bones of giant Kodo

Go.  Blow this horn when you reach his lair.  Blow the horn, and he will come.
881-accept.title: Echeyakee

881-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-complete.text:
You've beaten Echeyakee, and though his days of hunting are over... his spirit is with you.  He will show you the strength found in subtlety, and the honor in mercy.

Your path is still long, $c.  Let's hope you stride it well.
881-complete.title: Echeyakee

881-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
881-progress.text: The great cat calls to you, $N.
881-progress.title: Echeyakee

887-progress.name: Gazlowe
887-progress.text: I don't even want to think about the profits I've lost from pirate raiding, and now they set up camp on my doorstep? It's getting out of hand, Undermine's got to do something about it.
887-progress.title: Southsea Freebooters

890-progress.name: Wharfmaster Dizzywig
890-progress.text: Wares to send on the next ship, $N?
890-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

892-progress.name: Gazlowe
892-progress.text: So, what did Dizzywig have to say?
892-progress.title: The Missing Shipment

895-progress.name: Gazlowe
895-progress.text: What's happening? Something I can help you with? Goods to ship, perhaps an engineering job?
895-progress.title: WANTED: Baron Longshore

899-accept.name: Mankrik
899-accept.text:
Perhaps you know the pain of uncertainty, perhaps not, $c. But know this: I stand here every day, from the sun's rising till its decline, scouring the horizon for more of those monsters. I've killed every pig man I've come across since, but my thirst for their blood is far from quenched. Perhaps instead of heading north to the Crossroads I should have headed to Taurajo.

You, $c--you  could help me.

Kill them. Kill as many as you can. Bring me their tusks, and we will celebrate their deaths together.
899-accept.title: Consumed by Hatred

900-progress.name: Unknown
900-progress.text: Blinking lights on the control console indicate that the main control valves have not been closed off.
900-progress.title: Samophlange

901-progress.name: Unknown
901-progress.text: The console lights are dimmed and the gauges and dials all read at their zero positions, everything idling.
901-progress.title: Samophlange

903-complete.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-complete.text: Ah, I see you've been busy, lurking in the grasses and hunting prowlers.  Do you think, then, it is time to face a champion among them?
903-complete.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

903-progress.name: Sergra Darkthorn
903-progress.text: How goes your hunt, $N?  Have you found the prowlers?
903-progress.title: Prowlers of the Barrens

905-accept.name: Sergra Darkthorn
905-accept.text:
Now, $N, the hunt deepens.  Now you must defeat your prey, and then find your way to its lair.

Hunt the sunscale raptors to the south.  Slay them and remove the feathers they wear.  Place the feathers on the scytheclaw nests southwest of the Stagnant Oasis. Show their brethren you do not fear them!
905-accept.title: The Angry Scytheclaws

91921-progress.name: Quinn Yorick
91921-progress.text: You return! I was beginning to come to terms with devolving into a ghoul.
91921-progress.title: Return to Quinn (Again)

95314-progress.name: Carolai Anise
95314-progress.text: I trust you did not get lost?
95314-progress.title: That Shadowvale Green Elixir

95328-accept.name: Unknown
95328-accept.text: Against your better judgement you scrape up and collect the squirming remains of the beast. Someone in Undercity might have a use for them.
95328-accept.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95328-complete.name: Father Lankester
95328-complete.text:
What an interesting specimen. From underneath the Whispering Forest, you say? It's no secret that foul place is touched by the void.

I welcome the opportunity to explore the mysteries of shadow, $c. Allow me to offer you payment for what you've found.
95328-complete.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95328-progress.name: Father Lankester
95328-progress.text: Do you have something for me, $c?
95328-progress.title: Whispering Horror Residue

95495-progress.name: Walton
95495-progress.text: Greetings, $c. What brings you up to my property today?
95495-progress.title: The Hermit Tanner

95507-progress.name: Vrang Wildgore
95507-progress.text: <Vrang grunts at you as you approach.>
95507-progress.title: Vrang's Game

95621-progress.name: Walton
95621-progress.text:
The remnants of Daelin Proudmoore's fleet who still fly his banner are just as rotten and barbaric as the admiral himself was before he died.

I don't know why they are so far from Tiragarde, but it can't be good.
95621-progress.title: Trouble in the Valley

96895-accept.name: Deathguard Terrence
96895-accept.text:
Not sure if you heard, but two emissaries of the Argent Dawn just passed through here. I don't mind the Argent Dawn, but I don't like them poking around Tirisfal unsupervised either. They were both Forsaken... but that doesn't make me any less nervous.

One of them just passed by here, headed southeast. There's a group of scourge cultists snooping around the outskirts of the city in that direction. If those two heard about them, there's no doubt that would have caught their attention.
96895-accept.title: The Argent Emissary

96897-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96897-accept.text: The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.
96897-accept.title: The Cult of the Damned

96898-accept.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-accept.text:
It wasn't long ago that the citadel of Naxxramas bore down upon this city, intent on wiping the Forsaken off the map. Both the Forsaken and the Argent Dawn lost much that day to secure the future of the Forsaken.

During the battle, the great necrotic focusing crystal hanging beneath Naxxramas was shattered and its fragments were scattered all over this area. I suspect that is what the cultists are here for. Help me recover the fragments and deprive the Scourge of them.
96898-accept.title: Remnants of War

96898-progress.name: Hadric Harlson
96898-progress.text: I'd advise you not come into too much physical contact with those crystals. Even shattered and spent, the lingering magic in these necrotic crystals is highly dangerous.
96898-progress.title: Remnants of War

96899-complete.name: Leonid Barthalomew the Revered
96899-complete.text:
This place is full of memories for me. This place was once held by the Argent Dawn. It was from here that we prepared for many battles and skirmishes against the Scourge during their most recent push into Tirisfal Glades.

When we withdrew to the Plaguelands I feared it would fall into disrepair. My fear was well-founded, but I am glad that Danitha and her paladins have taken over stewardship of it now.

She even named the keep after... a mutual friend.
96899-complete.title: Bandarion Keep

97242-progress.name: Kor'geld
97242-progress.text: We discover formulations and recipes by showing old ingredients to new generations, who experiment with them in their own way.
97242-progress.title: Yelmak's Medley

97558-complete.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-complete.text: Ah, excellent! Thank you for acquiring these. I can promise they will be put to good use.
97558-complete.title: Hides for the Forsaken

97558-progress.name: Shelene Rhobart
97558-progress.text:
Have you gathered the skin I inquired about? Our stocks are running low.

It may seem odd to ask for murloc skin but it works well for internal membranes, or surfaces like cheeks or mouths.

Similarly, the duskbat wing membranes are especially suited for more delicate areas, like faces or fingers. It prevents the skin from being too... thick.
97558-progress.title: Hides for the Forsaken

98545-progress.name: Glix Xizzix
98545-progress.text: What's that? You say that Leonid sent you? Oh boy, haven't seen that crusty old soldier since Naxxramas was raining hell down on our heads.
98545-progress.title: Leonid's Letter

99142-progress.name: Junior Apothecary Holland
99142-progress.text: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
99142-progress.title: Tomb Weed

99152-complete.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-complete.text: Well done, $c. With these bones we may be able to better understand how such a threat was able to go unnoticed for so long.
99152-complete.title: As Above, So Below

99152-progress.name: Hilda the Breaker
99152-progress.text: You'd best not be returning empty-handed. I either need the bones I asked for, or your body on a stretcher to confirm you at least gave it your all trying to get them.
99152-progress.title: As Above, So Below

99153-progress.name: Ephram Barbaro
99153-progress.text: Did you find the damned thing?
99153-progress.title: The One That Got Away
